summary: Aerodrome EGNT not available to non-scheduled traffic; overflying aircraft needing a crossing clearance should file a flight plan.
text:
AD NOT AVBL TO NON-SCHEDULED TFC. OVERFLYING ACFT REQUIRING A XNG
